reason: A cross-platform native desktop client that wraps DeepSeek Harness, manages its local agent service, and adds desktop interactions such as tray access, shortcuts, and file drag-and-drop.

summaries.zh: 这是一个将 DeepSeek Harness 封装为跨平台原生桌面客户端的工具，支持本地智能体服务管理、系统托盘、快捷键以及文件和代码项目拖放。
summaries.en: A cross-platform native desktop client for DeepSeek Harness with local agent service management, system tray access, keyboard shortcuts, and file or code-project drag and drop.

capabilities: desktop application wrapper for DeepSeek Harness
launches and manages a local background agent service
supports local file and code-project drag and drop
provides system tray and keyboard shortcut interactions
